content: SPIKE-03 enumeration, verified by reading the Core sources: exactly 11 'public static IReadOnlyList<SettingGroup> Build()' methods exist, all zero-arg, all 'public static class' and none partial, all under AkariTool.Core/Features. Optimize (6): GamingOptimizations, PrivacyOptimizations, PowerOptimizations, NotificationsOptimizations, SoundOptimizations, UpdateOptimizations, in namespace AkariTool.Tabs.<Domain>. Customize (5): DesktopOptimizations, AppearanceOptimizations, TaskbarOptimizations, StartMenuOptimizations, ExplorerOptimizations, all in namespace AkariTool.Tabs.Customize. They cover Optimize and Customize ONLY. SoftwareApps has no Build method; it exposes four differently shaped factories in namespace AkariTool.Tabs - ExternalAppCatalog.GetExternalApps(), WindowsAppCatalog.GetWindowsApps(), CapabilityCatalog.GetWindowsCapabilities(), OptionalFeatureCatalog.GetWindowsOptionalFeatures() - each returning AppGroup (record with required Name, string? Icon, required FeatureId, required IReadOnlyList<AppDefinition> Items) with AppDefinition.Id. So 'every Akari setting ID' needs 15 entry points, not 11. Raw Id-literal counts by grep: Software 606, Optimize 465, Customize 150, so the 11 Build methods alone would miss roughly 55 percent of Akari setting IDs. SettingGroup is a sealed record with Name, FeatureId and IReadOnlyList<SettingDefinition> Settings and has no Id of its own, so enumeration is group.Settings.Select(s => s.Id). SettingPageWarmUp is NOT reusable as a test enumeration seam: Run(IServiceProvider, WinUI.Framework.Services.ILogService) needs a live container, SettingBackupService via GetRequiredService and INewBadgeService, and page.Build() internally calls ServiceLocator.GetService<T>() (CONCERNS item 9, 48 sites). The 15 static factories need no DI at all. SettingCatalogValidator is already public static in Core (Validate(SettingGroup) at line 51, Validate(IEnumerable<SettingGroup>) at line 68, CatalogViolation record at line 12). ID scheme divergence: Optimize IDs identical to Winhance (gaming-game-mode) and SoftwareApps identical (windows-app-3d-viewer), but Customize differs (Akari customize-explorer-show-file-extensions vs Winhance explorer-customization-shortcut-suffix), so a raw set-diff reports Customize almost 100 percent divergent and the report must normalise.
